title: Weighted blowups and 3d Poisson desingularizations
summary: We establish existence of functorial orbifold reductions of singularities for Poisson subvarieties in smooth Poisson threefolds. Namely, we show that with enough weighted blowups, one can reduce the singularities of such Poisson subvarieties to certain simple, explicit, local normal forms: Du Val surface singularities where the Poisson structure is locally Jacobian, and plane curves lying in the vanishing locus of a particular linear Poisson structure.
